scope: Subsequent main study only; suites/s1-retrofit/cr1 and the current fixed CR1 remain unchanged

randomization.unit: model/replicate block; all five arms in a block receive the same request
randomization.rule: Within each model, randomly permute each three-request deck using the fixed seed and consume without replacement; repeat decks until the prospectively fixed follow-up block count is met
randomization.release: Only release the assigned request when its session starts; no pool text in feature/post prompts or candidate seeds
randomization.analysis: Block by model and request; report all assignments, acquisition strata, missingness, whole-run effects and assistance. Request difficulty is not assumed equal.

requests.title: Versioned priority policy
requests.story: A programme manager needs a second auditable ranking policy without changing existing policy-v1 behavior.
rules: rank_cases(policy_version='v1') remains byte-for-byte compatible in score, codes and ordering.

Accept policy_version='v2' on the Workbench and every read-only view. V2 changes only VULNERABLE to +60 and PAUSED to -50; retain all other F9 scores, code order, held-first ordering and case-id tie-breaks.
Any policy version other than v1 or v2 raises ValidationError without changing state.
Ranking is a read, appends no audit entry and preserves all previously specified permissions, filtering and export behavior.

requests.title: Read-only audit pagination
requests.story: An auditor needs deterministic incremental audit retrieval without weakening hash verification or mutating the trail.
rules: Add audit_page(after_seq=0, limit=50) on the Workbench, returning copies of entries with seq greater than after_seq in increasing seq order, limited to at most limit entries.
after_seq must be a nonnegative integer and limit an integer from 1 to 100; reject bools and invalid arguments with ValidationError, without state or audit changes.

Returned mutations cannot change the source trail. Empty/beyond-end pages return an empty list. Preserve all F9 ranking behavior and existing role/view permissions; do not expose the trail through a view that previously lacked audit access.

requests.title: Priority-ordered CSV export
requests.story: A manager needs a ranked case export while contractors retain the same information minimization.
rules: Add export_ranked_cases_csv(role, policy_version='v1', **filters) on the Workbench. Use the unchanged F10 CSV columns and F9 ranking order, retaining only cases accepted by list_cases(**filters).
Add the corresponding method on existing read-only views, using their existing role and visibility rules. Contractor vulnerability/contact fields remain empty.
Unknown roles or policies raise ValidationError; exports are reads and create no audit entries. Preserve all prior writes, audit chaining, permissions and default export order.

acceptance_requirements: Independent difficulty and visible/hidden oracle review before follow-up source freeze
New exact-source immutable examples/hidden panels/reference snapshots; triplicate all-pass reference agreement
Prospective follow-up sample/resource/deadline amendment before collection, no outcome-driven choice of request
Bounded mutation report with generated/observed/equivalent/unavailable denominators; no universal adequacy claim
